cohort: Pregnant women who were referred to a maternal-fetal medicine unit between June 2015 and December 2019
finding: While no significant difference was found in first- and second-trimester uterine artery PI MoM values between previous cesarean and vaginal delivery groups, the IUGR rate was higher in the cesarean delivery group.
mod_finding: While previous cesarean delivery did not significantly affect uterine artery blood flow indices in subsequent pregnancies, it was associated with a higher rate of intrauterine growth restriction.
